title: أقل الصلاحيات
rule:
Applies when: When exposing tools or resources.
Provide only the necessary resource and operation scope; enforce critical file, network, credential and service boundaries outside the model.
rationale: الصلاحيات الواسعة قد تسمح بآثار محمية خارج التفويض. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
